$comment: Valid ErrorEntry fixture — axios-style HTTP error. Used by schema/site/mcp tests.
documentation: Axios rejects with `ERR_BAD_RESPONSE` when the server returns a status code that fails the request's `validateStatus` check. By default any status outside the range 200–399 is treated as an error.
triggerScenarios: Calling `axios.get(url)` against an endpoint that returns a non-2xx status (e.g. 404, 500, 416) when `validateStatus` has not been relaxed.
commonSituations: Server is down (500), route missing (404), Range Not Satisfiable (416), or auth expired (401/403). Also seen when a proxy returns an unexpected intermediate status.
solutions: Inspect `error.response.status` and `error.response.data` to handle the specific status code.
Pass `validateStatus: (s) => s < 500` to accept 4xx as non-errors.
Add a response interceptor to normalize error shape app-wide.
typeGuard: function isAxiosError(e): e is import('axios').AxiosError { return Boolean(e?.isAxiosError); }
preventionTips: Set `validateStatus` per-call instead of globally over-loosening it.
Use response interceptors for centralized error mapping.
